current_state.zh: Reth v2.9.0 replaces revm with evm2 as its EVM engine — a breaking change for SDK users that delivers roughly 10% faster block execution, along with engine, RPC, storage and pipeline bug fixes, snap-sync metrics, JIT support in reth-bb, and lighter builds.
